raw.query: SELECT d.run_id, l.mean_ttft_ms AS avg_ttft, p.p99_ms AS p99_ttft, p.max_ms AS max_ttft FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p ON d.run_id = p.run_id JOIN provenance.llm_run_summary l ON d.run_id = l.run_id WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND p.sla_metric = 'ttft' AND d.run_id IN ('srcbuild:llm_head2k_poly_src', 'srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src')
raw.observed: poly: avg 67.30 ms, p99 248.46 ms, max 2539.91 ms; aic: avg 68.23 ms, p99 307.36 ms, max 4517.57 ms
raw.evidence: The non-superseded current runs (srcbuild:llm_head2k_poly_src and srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src) in v_pool_latency and llm_run_summary show Polynomial TTFT avg 67.30 ms, p99 248.46 ms, max 2539.91 ms, and AIC TTFT avg 68.23 ms, p99 307.36 ms, max 4517.57 ms.
